title: Easy Teriyaki Steak Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds top sirloin, sliced thinly into ~1 inch pieces
Low sodium soy sauce, a couple dashes (for seasoning steak)
1/2 cup low sodium soy sauce (for sauce)
instructions: Take around 1 1/2 pounds of top sirloin and slice thinly into about 1 inch pieces. Add to a bowl and season well with pepper and a couple dashes of low sodium soy sauce. Mix. Then add 1/2 a tablespoon of corn starch and toss well.

Make the sauce by mixing 1 cup of water with 1/2 cup of low sodium soy sauce, 1 1/2 teaspoons of ginger paste, 2 tablespoons of honey, and 1/4 cup of brown sugar. Then add 1 tablespoon of corn starch and whisk. Set aside for later.
To a large skillet add around 1 tablespoon of oil. Heat to medium-high. Once heated, add steak. Cook 2 minutes then flip for another 2 minutes. Remove from pan.

Set heat to low-medium and add 1-2 tablespoons of oil. Then add 3 cloves of garlic, chopped. Toss for just a minute. Then add 3 cups of day-old cooked rice. Toss around 3 minutes getting the rice a little toasty.
Add sauce to the rice. Keep stirring until well combined and thickened. Then add steak back in.
notes: Posted by Andrea on Facebook. Day-old rice works best for fried rice — it's drier and toasts up better. Can use any cut of beef sliced thin.
